name: Roof replacement
summary: Full tear-off to the deck, new underlayment, and a new roof — usually finished in one day.

name: Leak and roof repair
summary: Missing shingles, lifted flashing, a stain on the ceiling. Found, photographed, and fixed.

name: Hail and storm damage
summary: A free inspection with photos of every hit, and a crew lead who meets your adjuster on the roof.

name: Metal roofing
summary: Standing-seam steel in twelve colours. Class 4 hail rated and good for fifty years.

name: Gutters and ventilation
summary: Seamless gutters, ridge vents, and attic airflow that keeps shingles from cooking in August.
